WD-ANAL.description: Wall Design Analysis (WD-ANAL). Runs RC wall design analysis per KDS-41-20-2022; the request body selects which walls and stories to design via the optional SELECTIONS list.

Argument.description: Request DTO (DESIGN_ANAL_WALL). Specifies the walls and stories to perform design analysis for.

SELECTIONS.description: List of wall and story selections to perform design for. If omitted or empty, all walls and all stories are included.

items.description: One selection pair: a set of Wall IDs plus a set of Story names.

WALL_IDS.description: Wall ID Object - Specify Each Wall ID (KEYS) or Wall ID Range (TO). If omitted, all walls are included.

STORY.description: Story names to filter design analysis. If omitted, all stories are included.
